#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long repunit[20];
long long power10[20];
int minSteps = -1;

void initialize() {
    power10[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 17; ++i) {
        power10[i] = power10[i-1] * 10;
    }
    repunit[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 17; ++i) {
        repunit[i] = repunit[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
}

int digitCount(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) return 1;
    int cnt = 0;
    while (n > 0) {
        ++cnt;
        n /= 10;
    }
    return cnt;
}

void search(int position, long long value, int steps) {
    if (minSteps != -1 && steps >= minSteps) return;
    
    if (value == 0 || position == 0) {
        if (minSteps == -1) minSteps = steps;
        else minSteps = min(minSteps, steps);
        return;
    }
    
    if (value < 0) value = -value;
    
    long long remainder = value;
    int stepCount = 0;
    while (remainder >= power10[position - 1]) {
        remainder -= repunit[position];
        stepCount += position;
    }
    search(position - 1, remainder, steps + stepCount);
    
    remainder = repunit[position + 1] - value;
    stepCount = 0;
    while (remainder >= power10[position - 1]) {
        remainder -= repunit[position];
        stepCount += position;
    }
    search(position - 1, remainder, steps + position + 1 + stepCount);
}

void solve() {
    long long input;
    cin >> input;
    minSteps = -1;
    search(digitCount(input), input, 0);
    cout << minSteps << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    initialize();
    solve();
    return 0;
}
